content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: LWC Screen Flow Component ## slug: vt-lwc-screen-flow-component ## seoTitle: LWC Screen Flow Component ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Drag and drop the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} into a Screen Flow to create a seamless experience for your customers or internal {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} users. ![VT LWC Screen Flow Component](https://youtu.be/33HWyoTAr08){height="480" width="640"} With Screen Flows and the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}}, Admins and Developers can create an even more seamless payment experiences for {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} and Experience Cloud users with clicks instead of code. :::(Warning) (NOTE) Custom Metadata Types and Custom Settings are not respected in the screen flow component. ::: 1. Create a new screen flow. 2. Add a Screen Element and provide a Label. 3. In the Components tab scroll down to the Custom section. 4. Find {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}} and drag the component to a section of the screen. 5. Configure the following input variables. * {{variable.Field_VT_APIName}}: This is how the component on this screen will be referenced in the rest of your flow. * {{variable.Field_VT_Amount}} * {{variable.Field_VT_Currency}}: The value from the related {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_CurrencyISO}} field will automatically populate this field. If the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}'s {{variable.Field_Invoice_CurrencyISO}} field is blank, the Virtual Terminal will use the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}’s {{variable.Field_PG_DefaultCurrency}} value. * {{variable.Field_VT_Description}} * {{variable.Field_VT_EnableLiteVersion}} – Known issue affecting functionality. * {{variable.Field_VT_HideAmount}} * {{variable.Field_VT_HideCurrency}} * {{variable.Field_MgVTCustmSet_HideBankTab}}: If enabled, Bank details will be hidden from the list of available options when creating a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} via the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}}. * {{variable.Field_VT_HideProcessType}} = "True." * {{variable.Field_MgVTCustomSet_MakeCVCOpt}}: If enabled, the {{variable.Field_VT_CVC}} field will be optional when adding a {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} via the {{variable.Component_BTLWCVirtualTerminal}}. * Parent Object {{variable.Field_VT_APIName}} * {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentGatewayID}} * {{variable.Field_VT_PaymentMethodID}} * {{variable.Field_VT_Process_Type}} = "Capture Now" * Record Id * {{variable.Field_VT_ShowAddress}} 6. Set Component Visibility (optional). 7. Set Advanced settings (optional).
